- Many berries have dark/black blotchy patches covering portions of the fruit
- Some berries appear entirely dark/blackened
- Mixed stages of ripeness (red, green, dark)
- Bare woody stems visible

Affected part: **pod/berry**. This narrows candidates to Berry_Blotch and Brown_Eye_Spot (both affect berries).

Berry_Blotch matches best: "brown irregular spots on berries, sometimes covering the whole berry; young fruit tend to ripen prematurely." The large dark patches covering much of the berry surface fits better than Brown_Eye_Spot's "smaller irregular brown spots mainly on sun-exposed side."

Now I'll use my 1 reference view on Berry_Blotch pod image to confirm.

The reference Berry_Blotch pod image shows the same pattern: dark/blackened berries, brown irregular blotching covering significant portions of the fruit, and bare woody stems. This matches the test image very well.

Both images show:
- Berries with extensive dark/black blotching
- Some berries completely blackened
- Bare woody branch structure
- Mixed stages of infection
